6d66502ec4e40b1a02b150ae0c248e72c1347b0e.summary: This is a vendor video landing page from CheckMAL, a security product company. Its main content promotes the AppCheck anti-ransomware product and its video library. It has a short, minimal indicator block for a ransomware called WhiteBlackGroup (.encrpt3d), but the page is mainly product marketing, so it is not treated as a threat report.
